_about: How the turn directions from Ride with GPS are worded in the Ride Guide (on screen and spoken). Ride with GPS keeps its own short cue sheet wording; the app reads them as full, natural sentences. fixes: a whole cue, exactly as written in Ride with GPS, and what the app says instead (if the cue is later changed in Ride with GPS, the new wording is used and tidied by the rules). rules: applied in order to every cue that has no fix (find is a regular expression, say the replacement). The build lists any cue that still reads like cue sheet shorthand in health.json (cueWording) so a rule or fix can be added. Ben, 15/10/2026: say 'the path', 'the car park' and so on.
